name: Pierre Bourdieu
shortBio: French sociologist and public intellectual; formulated habitus, cultural capital, social fields, and symbolic violence to explain how social hierarchies reproduce.
centralQuestion: How do unconscious bodily dispositions (habitus) and unequal cultural capital reproduce class domination without conscious coercion?

keyWorks.title: Outline of a Theory of Practice
keyWorks.description: Develops habitus and practical sense in opposition to both objectivism and subjectivism.

keyWorks.title: Distinction: A Social Critique of the Judgement of Taste
keyWorks.description: Voted one of the 20th century's most important sociological works on cultural taste.
